# Indiana Carpet & Upholstery

> Carpet & upholstery cleaning based in Bloomington, Indiana. Homes, apartments and businesses around Bloomington. Carpets, furniture and car upholstery cleaned, bleach spots dyed back, and soaked carpet dried out fast. Friendly, experienced and trustworthy, say our customers.

## Services
- Carpet cleaning: Whole-house or a room at a time. We work the traffic lanes and the stains until the carpet looks like carpet again.
- Upholstery cleaning: Couches, chairs and the rest of the furniture that takes a beating. Same care as the carpet.
- Car upholstery: Seats and carpet in your car, truck or van. One customer had us do her house and her car the same visit.
- Water extraction: AC leak, burst line, flooded basement. We pull the water out of the carpet so it can dry before it turns into a bigger problem.
- Stain & bleach spot dyeing: Got a bleach spot in the living room carpet? We can dye it back so you stop moving the furniture to hide it.
- Apartments & commercial: Property managers and businesses call us for hallways, units and offices, including the urgent ones.

## About
Indiana Carpet & Upholstery is the red barn with the big ICU letters on East State Road 45, just outside Bloomington. Most folks call us ICU, and we answer to it. We clean carpet and upholstery for homes, apartments and businesses: carpets, couches, car seats, soaked carpet after a leak, and bleach spots we dye back so they disappear. Apartment managers around town call us when a unit floods, and we show up. And if you stop by the office, you'll see why one customer called it "an eclectic and unique atmospheric experience." Neon signs, slot machines, Coke crates, a Bloomington sign and an IU Hoosiers Ave street sign. We take the cleaning seriously. The decorating, less so.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: My carpet is soaked from a leak. Can you come out?
  A: Yes. Water extraction is one of the main things we do. Call (812) 333-1870 and tell us what happened. One customer's apartment manager called us on a Saturday and our tech was there in under an hour.
- Q: Can you fix a bleach spot in my carpet?
  A: Often, yes. We do spot dyeing for bleach stains, so the spot blends back in instead of you replacing the carpet or hiding it under a chair.
- Q: Do you clean car upholstery?
  A: Yes. We clean car, truck and van seats and floor carpet, and we can do your car the same visit as your house.
- Q: Do you work with apartment managers and businesses?
  A: Yes. We do residential and commercial work, including hallways, units and offices, and we work as a subcontractor for property managers.
- Q: Where are you?
  A: 5998 E State Rd 45, Bloomington, IN 47408. Look for the red barn with the big white ICU letters and the white garage door.
- Q: How do I get a price?
  A: Call (812) 333-1870 or use the estimate form. Tell us what needs cleaning (rooms, furniture, car) and we'll get back to you.
